blocks.text: AMD Ryzen 7000 Series Performance Built in Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 7430U (Processor) Number of Physical Cores: 6 Core, 12 Thread (Processor) Turbo Speed: Up to 4.3 GHz Graphics: Integrated AMD Radeon Graphics Operating System: Windows 11 Pro Memory: Up to 64GB DDR4 RAM Hard Drive: Up to 2TB PCIe NVMe SSD Display: 17.3" Full HD (1920 × 1080) IPS Anti-Glare Display Connectivity: Wi-Fi 6 (2x2) and Bluetooth 5.3 Ports: 2 x USB-A 3.2; 1 x USB-C; 1 x HDMI; 1 x Headphone / microphone combo jack; 1 x SD card reader Built-in Speakers: Dual Stereo Speakers Keyboard: Full-Size Backlit Keyboard, US English Built-in HD Webcam: Integrated 720p HD Camera with Privacy Shutter and Dual Microphones Color: Silver Power Adapter (Included): 45W Smart AC Adapter Dimensions L x W x H (inches): 15.78 x 10.15 x 0.78 Inches Weight: Starting at 4.6 lbs Accessories: WOWPC Recovery USB for easy system repair and troubleshooting

items: 【Display】17.3-inch Full HD (1920 × 1080) IPS anti-glare display with wide viewing angles and vivid color accuracy, offering ample screen space for multitasking, productivity, and extended use.
【Processor】Powered by AMD Ryzen 5 7430U with 6 cores, 12 threads, and up to 4.3GHz Turbo Boost, delivering smooth multitasking, responsive performance, and integrated AMD Radeon Graphics.
【AI Copilot】Preloaded with Windows 11 Pro and featuring a dedicated Copilot key, enabling AI-powered assistance to simplify tasks, optimize workflows, and boost efficiency right out of the box.
【Memory & Storage】Configured with up to 32GB DDR4 RAM for seamless multitasking and a fast 1TB PCIe NVMe SSD for quick boot-up, rapid file access, and secure storage of large projects and media.

【Accessories & Connectivity】Comes with a WOWPC Recovery USB for easy system repair and troubleshooting, plus Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth 5.3, 720p HD webcam with privacy shutter, dual microphones, and AMD FreeSync for fluid visuals.
